Implementing the fix: `_is_success` only checks top-level fields, but live tool results carry success in nested `content`/`_raw_content` JSON.
Bounded M3.3 delegated worker task completed.

**Root cause:** `step_trace_extractor._is_success` only checked top-level `success`/`status`. Live finalizer tool results use `role`/`name`/`content` or `_raw_content` with `status: ok` nested in JSON, so successful calendar+weather steps were skipped and no routine offer was appended.

**Fix:** Parse `content`/`_raw_content` when top-level status is absent and treat nested `status: ok` (or `success: true`) as success. Name alias canonicalization (`calendar_list_events` â†’ `calendar.list_events`, `system_weather` â†’ `system.weather`) was already in place.

- `backend/services/workflow/step_trace_extractor.py`
- `backend/tests/test_workflow_detector.py`
- `backend/tests/test_workflow_offer_service.py`
